events.summary: Worcester 20s & 30s Social at Bay State Brewery

description.plain:
Friday, March 13, 2026 | 6:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX0000012QaX2AU/
Join the Worcester Chapter 20s & 30s for a casual social at Bay State Brewery in downtown Worcester! The event will take place on Friday, March 13th, starting at 6:00 pm. We welcome new and longtime friends to come learn about all of the exciting upcoming trips and activities this winter and spring. Plus, meet like-minded outdoors enthusiasts and leaders from the Worcester Chapter! Bay State Brewery has food, beer, and non-alcoholic options available. The event starts at 6:00, but feel free to come when you can!For more info about Bay State Brewery, visit: Bay State Brewery
